hookups.source: https://web.archive.org/web/20250714034547/https://shadyoaksrvcampground.com/ (operator's page, Wayback 2025-07-14: 'Electric & Water RV Sites', 'spacious, well-maintained RV sites with Electric & Water Hookups'). The stored sewer came from note prose; the operator lists electric and water only (a review says sewer setups are at the seasonal sites), so it is cleared.

note: Private campground between Au Gres and Tawas City along the Au Gres East Branch River, with tent areas, a playground and riverside fishing; separate seasonal and daily/weekend areas. --Claude
summary: The operator site is down for maintenance (HTTP 503, 2026-10-22); its July 2025 capture shows electric & water RV sites, tent sites, a drive-thru flush (dump) station, seasonal and daily campers, phone (248) 763-1973, and no rates. Confirmed water and dump; cleared sewer (note-derived; nightly sites are electric & water only). Google Maps: 4.6 stars from 161 reviews, same 248 phone. No rate anywhere from the operator, so fees stay empty.
flags: Website: http://shadyoaksrvcampground.com answers HTTP 503 'Maintenance - Please check back soon' (2026-10-22); last good capture 2025-07-14 (Wayback). Presence passes on Google Maps instead: 4.6 stars / 161 reviews, phone (248) 763-1973, site link the same domain (open/closed status not shown in the read).
Phone: the operator's site and Google Maps both give (248) 763-1973; the entry has 989-362-3947.

No posted nightly rate (operator site never listed one; no booking engine, 'Contact us to book'). Price indicator is RV Life $ only. Seasonal share not published: the park has separate seasonal and daily/weekend areas and several reviewers are multi-year seasonals, but the operator markets nightly RV and tent stays, so it reads as mixed rather than long-stay in character.
